title: Print Report Permissions — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Which print reports the users in one role may run. A user sees the reports granted to any of their roles. A user with no grants sees none, but company administrators and host users always see every active report. Each role can have one entry.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: Role
fields.rules: Required. Chosen from Role master data.
fields.html:
What it is. The role being granted reports.

Example. Payroll
